notes: Cost stays under your $500/month ceiling at expected traffic
Biggest lever if you need to cut: drop RDS to single-AZ (~$50 saved) at the cost of failover speed
At 5x traffic expect roughly $600-900/month — mostly compute and data transfer

security.posture: Strong baseline. All compute and data live in private subnets; only the ALB and CloudFront are internet-facing. Encryption enforced at rest (KMS) and in transit (TLS 1.2+).

risks.description: GDPR data residency: any service accidentally deployed outside eu-central-1 would violate residency requirements
risks.mitigation: Use AWS Organizations SCPs to deny non-eu-central-1 regions; pin all IaC to the region

risks.description: S3 bucket with user uploads could be exposed by misconfiguration
risks.mitigation: Enable S3 Block Public Access at the account level; serve uploads via pre-signed URLs only

risks.description: No web-layer attack filtering by default
risks.mitigation: AWS WAF managed rule sets on CloudFront (already in the design) — keep rules updated

risks.description: No audit trail of API/API-console actions
risks.mitigation: Enable CloudTrail in eu-central-1 with log file validation

compliance_notes: GDPR: data residency satisfied by eu-central-1 pinning
GDPR: right-to-erasure needs an application-level delete pipeline (cascading deletes + S3 lifecycle)
GDPR: sign the AWS Data Processing Addendum (DPA)
Encryption at rest via KMS on RDS, S3, and ElastiCache; TLS everywhere via ACM

bottlenecks: Single RDS primary writer — the first ceiling you'll hit (~5,000 writes/sec)
Fargate task count limited by account quotas (raise via support ticket)
ElastiCache single-node micro instance will need upgrading before 10k concurrent users
scalability.strategy: Scale stateless containers horizontally first; scale the database with read replicas before considering sharding.
mechanisms: ECS service autoscaling on CPU/memory targets (target 60%)
RDS read replicas for read-heavy dashboards
ElastiCache for sessions and hot queries to offload the DB
CloudFront caching for static assets and public reads
scalability.ceiling: ~50,000 concurrent users before the database needs sharding or a move to Aurora
